baseline_items.question: Show sales by year.

baseline_items.question: Which product category has the most sales?
baseline_items.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1;
